title: Geographic Subdivision Information in Subject Authority Records
summary: New geographic subject headings usable as geographic subdivisions carry a 781 field (second indicator 0) giving the subdivision form: one $z if used directly, two successive $z if used indirectly. Headings not valid as subdivisions (celestial bodies, structures or parks in cities, etc.) carry a 667 note "This heading is not valid for use as a geographic subdivision." Pre-1999 records used 680 notes.
validation_rules: A 781 field (second indicator 0) in a geographic subject authority record gives the exact geographic subdivision form: a single `$z` for direct use (e.g. `Arabah Valley (Israel and Jordan)` → `--Arabah Valley (Israel and Jordan)`), two successive `$z` for indirect use (e.g. `Halkyn Mountain (Wales)` → `--Wales--Halkyn Mountain`). (H 836 sec. 1)

A 667 field `This heading is not valid for use as a geographic subdivision.` means the heading may not be used as `$z` (e.g. `Andromeda Galaxy`; `Roosevelt Drive (Bedford Hills, N.Y.)`). (H 836 sec. 2)
Celestial bodies and structures or parks in cities are not valid as geographic subdivisions. (H 836 Background, sec. 2)
Older (pre-February 1999) records may express usage in a 680 note (e.g. `Samoan Islands`: "As a geographic subdivision, this heading is used directly."); follow it. (H 836 Background)
The 781 form is determined by H 830. (H 836 sec. 1)

sections.heading: 1. 781 field
sections.text:
When establishing a new geographic subject heading that may be used as a geographic subdivision, determine the form in which the heading is used as a geographic subdivision following the guidelines in H 830. Enter the text of the geographic subdivision form in a 781 field with second indicator 0. For a geographic heading that is used directly, enter the data in a single $z subfield. For a geographic heading that is used indirectly through a larger geographic entity, enter the data in two successive $z subfields. Examples:

```
151 ## $a Arabah Valley (Israel and Jordan)
781 #0 $z Arabah Valley (Israel and Jordan)

151 ## $a Halkyn Mountain (Wales)
781 #0 $z Wales $z Halkyn Mountain
```

sections.heading: 2. 667 field
sections.text:
For a geographic subject heading that may not be used as a geographic subdivision, such as a celestial body, a structure or park in a city, etc., add a 667 field to the record containing the following text:

```
667 ## $a This heading is not valid for use as a geographic subdivision.
```

Examples:

```
151 ## $a Andromeda Galaxy
667 ## $a This heading is not valid for use as a geographic subdivision.

151 ## $a Roosevelt Drive (Bedford Hills, N.Y.)
667 ## $a This heading is not valid for use as a geographic subdivision.
```
